guarantees.claim: For each i from 0 to NumRegsData-1, data_in[i] = reg2hw.data_in[i].q and data_in_qe[i] = reg2hw.data_in[i].qe.

assumptions.claim: reg2hw.data_in[i].q and .qe must not hold stale secret data (plaintext/key) when the AES core should not have access; the surrounding CSR logic must ensure proper clearing after use.
assumptions.risk: Secret plaintext or key data may be leaked into AES computation or read out via data_in array.

formal_sketch.consequent: reg2hw.data_in[i].q and .qe must not hold stale secret data (plaintext/key) when the AES core should not have access; the surrounding CSR logic must ensure proper clearing after use

security_implications: The data_in signal carries input data from the register interface, which may include secret plaintext or key material. This block directly forwards the register values without any masking or clearing. If the register file does not properly clear these fields after use, or if data_in_qe glitch enables unintended captures, secret data could leak into the AES datapath or be observable through other side-channels.
